h1: The 6 Best Office Storage Carts With Drawers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Office Storage Carts 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six rolling storage carts with drawers, from 4-drawer slim carts to 10-drawer towers, compared on capacity, casters and size.
summary: The LEHOM 8-drawer cart is our best overall pick for its stated weight limits and lockable wheels. The 10-drawer wooden-top cart holds the most, the IRIS 4-drawer is the compact pick, and the Goovilla suits craft and dorm use.
intro: Rolling carts look the same in photos, but the useful details sit in the specs: how much each drawer holds, how many casters lock, and how much floor the cart takes.
We ranked six drawer carts from our pool. A laptop charging cart and a duplicate listing of the 10-drawer model were dropped, because neither fits the title or adds a distinct pick.

products.name: LEHOM Rolling Storage Cart with 8 Drawers, Utility Cart on Lockable Wheels
products.verdict: Clear weight limits and a flat top in the $25-50 bucket.
products.description:
The LEHOM stands 31.18 inches tall on a 15.55 by 12.60 inch footprint, with 8 drawers and a wooden flat top. It lists 33 lb on the top plate and 11 lb per drawer, and sells in the $25-50 bucket.

It beats the SYKIARIOL because both list the same weights while this one costs a tier less and stands taller. Its partial locking casters steady the cart during drawer access.

Buy it if you want the most drawers for the least money. Only some casters lock, so do not load the top heavily.
products.idealFor: Home offices that need lots of small drawers cheaply.

products.name: 10 Drawers Rolling Cart with Wooden Tabletop, Utility Storage Cart with Wheels
products.verdict: Ten drawers and a scratch-resistant top, with tool-free assembly.
products.description:
This cart has 10 drawers, a waterproof and scratch-resistant wooden tabletop, and four 360 degree casters, two with brakes. Assembly is tool-free, and it falls in the $50-100 bucket.

It ranks second because it costs a tier more than the LEHOM for two extra drawers. Half-locking casters mean it needs the same care with loading.

Choose it for craft supplies, papers or parts with many categories. Its price makes it a want, not a need, for light storage.
products.idealFor: People with many categories of small items.

products.name: SYKIARIOL Rolling Storage Cart with Drawers, 8 Drawers Utility Cart, Black
products.verdict: A shorter 8-drawer cart with color-coded drawers and a rust-resistant frame.
products.description:
The SYKIARIOL measures 15.55 by 12.60 by 25.47 inches with 8 color-coded drawers. It lists 33 lb on the top and 11 lb per drawer, plus a rust-resistant frame and video-guided assembly. Cost-wise it is a $50-100 item.

It trails the LEHOM because the weights match but this one is shorter and costs more. Its color coding and video assembly help organization and setup.

Buy it if you want to sort items by color or want a lower cart that fits under a table.
products.skipIf: You want more height for less money.

products.name: IRIS USA 4-Drawer Rolling Storage Cart with Organizer Top, Black/Pearl
products.verdict: A compact Made in USA cart with an organizer top and drawer stops.
products.description:
The IRIS cart is 14.25 by 12.05 by 26.44 inches with 4 drawers and an organizer top. It has built-in drawer stops and removable wheels, is Made in USA, and sells in the $25-50 bucket.

It ranks below the 8-drawer carts because it has half the drawers at a similar price. Its advantages are the compact footprint, the organizer top and the drawer stops.

Pick it for a desk-side spot where narrow width matters. Its drawer count is small by design.

products.name: Rolling Cart with Drawers, 4-Drawer Storage Cart on Wheels with Wooden Top, Metal
products.verdict: Mesh drawers and a 150 lb frame rating for visible storage.
products.description:
This 4-drawer metal cart has a wooden top and a 150 lb frame capacity, with mesh drawers measuring 12 by 16.5 by 4.25 inches each. Cost-wise it is a $25-50 item.

It ranks fifth because the 150 lb figure is a frame rating, not a per-drawer limit. The mesh does let you see contents at a glance, which solid drawers do not.

Buy it for tools and supplies you want to spot quickly. Shallow drawers limit what fits.

products.name: Goovilla Rolling Cart with 5 Drawers for Craft, Art, Dorm, Office, White
products.verdict: Three shallow and two deep drawers in white, with a 40 lb top.
products.description:
The Goovilla has 5 drawers (3 shallow and 2 deep) in white with a 40 lb tabletop rating. Drawers detach and have pull-out limiters, with 11 lb per drawer. Its price tier is $25-50.

The missing dimensions push it to the bottom, since it lists no size and has fewer drawers than the bigger carts. The mixed depths make it handy for odd-shaped craft items.

Choose it for a dorm or craft corner. Check dimensions before you order.

methodology.description: We weighed capacity against the bucket each cart sits in.

whatMatters.detail: A cart lists how much its top and each drawer can hold. It matters because overloaded drawers sag or jam. Look for lb numbers in the bullets; a missing limit is a reason to be careful.
Casters are the wheels, and locking ones stop the cart rolling. It matters when you pull a drawer open. Read how many of the four wheels lock.
The width and depth decide whether the cart fits beside your desk. Measure the gap first. The listing dimensions give length, width and height.
A shallow drawer holds papers and cables but not bulky items. Match depth to what you store. Check drawer dimensions, not just overall size.
Tool-free or video-guided assembly saves time. It matters if you dislike hardware. The listing often states how the cart is put together.

faq.q: Why was the charging cart excluded?
faq.a: It is a laptop charging station, not a drawer storage cart, so it does not match the title.

faq.q: How much can each drawer hold?
faq.a: The LEHOM, SYKIARIOL and Goovilla list 11 lb per drawer.
Not on every model. The LEHOM has partial locking and the 10-drawer cart has two brakes on four casters.

faq.q: Is the 10-drawer cart worth it over the 8-drawer?
faq.a: Only if you need two extra categories. It costs a tier more.

faq.q: Which cart fits under a desk?
faq.a: The SYKIARIOL, at 25.47 inches tall, is the shortest with listed dimensions.

faq.q: Do mesh drawers hold small items?
faq.a: They show contents but are shallow at 4.25 inches, so tiny loose items can slip.

finalTake: The LEHOM 8-drawer cart is the best buy for most home offices thanks to clear weight limits and a low price. Step up to the 10-drawer cart for more capacity, or take the IRIS for tight spaces.
